subject: Request: stacking cohort credits for LaunchPad Accelerator
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@launchpad.vc>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: LaunchPad Operations <ops@launchpad.vc>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: stacking cohort credits for LaunchPad Accelerator

Hi Jordan,

Quick question on the promo credits for our upcoming Fall cohort. Several of our portfolio startups participated in the Summer pilot and received a 5k onboarding credit. For a handful of teams that are re-applying to Fall, they expect the Fall cohort promotion (3k) on top of the remaining Summer balance.

Your published terms say promo credits are non-stackable across programs, but LaunchPad has a couple of special cases (companies that were only able to use ~30% of the Summer credit due to infra delays). Can we get an exception to allow cohort stacking up to a combined cap of 6k for those teams? This would make the onboarding smoother and avoid churn.

Attached are the cohort schedule and the list of affected startups (redacted). Happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Samir
Director, LaunchPad Accelerator
Samir Gupta
ops@launchpad.vc
attachments: launchpad_cohort_schedule.pdf, promo_terms.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: stacking cohort credits for LaunchPad Accelerator

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the clear summary and for attaching the schedules. Short answer: our standard policy is that promotional credits tied to distinct programs are not stackable; we publish that to avoid duplicate subsidy on the same consumption window. That said, we often make manual carve-outs for accelerator partners when there was demonstrable under-consumption due to platform issues or onboarding delays.

Can you confirm two things so I can escalate to pricing ops:
- Which specific startups and their account IDs (HubSpot deal links are fine).
- Approx remaining balance on the Summer credit for each team (USD).

If you can send those, I’ll loop in Marissa from Partnerships and our pricing reviewer. If it’s a small list (<= 5) and the combined incremental exposure is under 6k total, I can usually get a fast-track approval.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Forwarding Samir's note. Jordan — thanks for flagging. Ben — can you run a quick exposure calc and confirm billing impact if we allowed stacking up to 6k total across the cohort? I also want to make sure nothing in the promo_terms.pdf (attached) legally blocks us.

Context for reviewers: LaunchPad is a strategic channel partner. Approving a limited stacking carve-out for a handful of founders materially increases adoption and is likely to bring multi-product consumption. We should consider allowing the exception but gate it with a one-time credit amendment and commit-to-consumption clause for the Fall (e.g., 3 months).

If Ben's calc looks safe (<= $6k gross revenue impact for Redwood), I propose we approve at Partner Ops level and require a short credit amendment (billing team) rather than a long contract redline. Lauren, do you want to sign off on the final language or should billing handle it under standard promo amendment?

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa / Jordan — I ran the numbers (quick calc attached). If we allow stacking but cap per-company combined credits at $6,000 and require the following gating items, the net impact is tidy:

- Affected list: 4 companies (IDs linked in HubSpot).
- Remaining Summer credit exposure (sum): $4,200.
- Fall promo credit proposed: $3,000 each (max), but stacking allowed only up to a combined per-company cap of $6,000.
- Worst-case outlay if all accept and consume: $6,000 * 4 = $24,000 credited. Our expected realized credit (based on usage patterns) is ~55% -> $13,200.

Recommendation: Approve a limited exception with these controls:
1) One-time billing amendment signed by the founder (DocuSign link below) that amends the promo application to allow stacking up to $6k for named companies.
2) 90-day consumption commitment for the Fall cohort — any unused credit after 90 days expires.
3) Apply standard anti-abuse flags; marketing/partner ops will confirm cohort identity.

I've put a draft credit amendment in the Drive (see link). Lauren — if you give a thumbs-up, we can send the DocuSign to Samir this afternoon.

Ben Carter
Sr. Revenue Operations Analyst
ben_carter@redwood.ai
